coordinate_system: original 1792x1792 north-up source pixels; different-year high roofs not registered by identical pixel

west_front_roof.interpretation: A continuous grey-green central surface is visible in 2015, including y960-970; there is no dark gabled roof continuation through this patch. West RC flat-front section with raised rose-window gable screen is the better-supported candidate. Repair exploded axonometry independently identifies RC roof but cannot alone determine footprint due to separated layers.
west_front_roof.uncertainty: Shadow and parallax prevent absolute wall-base dimensions; do not treat all visible white borders as coplanar roof edges.

warnings: Nominals are bounded reconstruction choices, not measured dimensions.
Do not add per-year roof projections to infer precise whole wall length.
Do not add flat strips along the entire long nave.
West five-part facade and three-part center gable must remain distinct from rear nave.
notes: 跨年影像及修復圖的有界解讀；不是測繪、官方標高或以明暗完全確證。來源URL見sources.json。
